title: VIDEO-TEXT DATASET CONSTRUCTION FROM MULTI-AI FEEDBACK: PROMOTING WEAK-TO-STRONG PREFERENCE LEARNING FOR VIDEO LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the bias inherent in traditional Video Question Answering (VQA) evaluation metrics that rely exclusively on text-only ground-truth matching. The paper demonstrates how this biases evaluation by unfairly penalizing accurate, highly-aligned model responses that diverge from incomplete or flawed ground-truth texts, and proposes a vision-aware, fine-grained LLM-as-a-judge scoring method to measure and eliminate this bias.
